name: University of Michigan-Ann Arbor
summary: Large public university in Ann Arbor, Michigan: 280+ degree programmes in 19 schools and colleges, with 97% of first-years living on campus.

ib.text: No IB points minimum is published. Admission weighs the strength of your curriculum (IB Diploma counts as rigour) with grades, essays and optional SAT or ACT. IB HL exams earn credit only after admission.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Business Administration
programmes.about: The four-year Michigan Ross business degree, with classes at Ross from first year and action-based learning in which students start, advise, invest in and lead real businesses.
programmes.selectionNote: About 80% of each BBA class enrols as high school seniors through Preferred Admission. Ross wants strong grades in quantitative courses and a competitive SAT or ACT.

flagshipSource.title: Michigan Ross: the BBA and its action-based learning (REAL)

faculties.name: College of Engineering
faculties.line: Apply to Engineering directly as a first-year or international applicant; it has its own admissions pages and advising sessions.

faculties.name: Ross School of Business (BBA)
faculties.line: Strong grades in quantitative courses, a competitive SAT or ACT, teamwork and leadership in activities.

notes: International students on temporary visas are not eligible for financial aid and are expected to pay the full cost of attendance; few scholarships exist.
2026-27 out-of-state tuition and fees in the College of Literature, Science and the Arts are $67,096 for years 1-2 and $71,798 from year 3; the total budget is $88,394 in the first two years.
Michigan reviews your application only once everything has arrived, and tells distant international applicants to send materials as early as possible.
